rationale.consistency: API and config additions are highly idiomatic and perfectly match existing repository conventions.
rationale.edge_cases: Fails to implement any of the required file validation, command, or upload edge cases.
rationale.scope: Extremely incomplete; implements only API struct additions and misses all core attachment and command logic.
